utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Kira—just a quick update: the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center. If you can spread the word, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming, it’s still the repair drive with Opal, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, that’s right — it’s still the repair drive with Opal, just moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what time the repair drive starts and which items need fixing most?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m still waiting on the final details too — do we have a date for the repair drive yet, or is that still being worked out?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet either—have you heard any date or time for it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I missed that it moved. Sunday at the community center, got it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Noah — that’s the one. I’ll send the details again just in case, and we should be good for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Perfect, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out for your message and be there Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, it’s still set for Saturday morning at the community center. If you can bring anything useful or help spread the word, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll send over the repair drive details and the school times next.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Leo — that sounds perfect. Send the details when you can, and I’ll help keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes — it’s still on, and Rosa said it’s now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks — Sunday at the community center works. If you send the exact time and what needs fixing, I’ll plan around school.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check with Rosa for the exact time and the list of repairs, then I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me—I'll be there at 10 Saturday by the community center, and I'll bring my gloves and a couple of tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Actually, it’s moved to Sunday at the community center now—same idea, just a new day. 10 still works, and gloves/tools would be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sunday at 10 at the community center works for me—I’ll bring my gloves and a couple of tools.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, still on — we’re gathering supplies this week for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I can help gather supplies—what do you still need? Also, I’ve got the updated note that it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great—thanks. I’ll check what’s missing and get back to you; Sunday at the community center works.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good, Vik — Sunday at the community center is noted. Send me the addresses when you have them, and I’ll keep track of the homes that still need repairs.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, Opal — I’ll send the addresses your way as soon as I have them and keep talking it up around the block.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Vik — I’ve got Sunday at the community center marked down. Just send the addresses when they’re ready, and I’ll keep the list organized.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring the ladder for sure, and I might have a drill too. What time do you need them?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey — let’s do Sunday at the community center, around 10 if that works. Your ladder would be great, and bring the drill if you can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sunday at 10 works for me. I’ll bring the ladder and check on the drill too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, it’s still on Sunday at the community center. We’ve got the hammer and screwdriver covered, and a wrench set would be great if you can find it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can bring a wrench set — I’ll check my toolbox and see if I’ve got one.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks, Dane. If you find it, bring the wrench set to the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please send the exact drop-off time and address so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I still need the exact drop-off time and address for the repair drive, but I’ll send them as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks—once you have the time and address, send them over and I’ll work around it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, that’s right — Sunday at the community center. And if you hear of any extra tools or supplies, send them my way so I can pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Will do — I’ll keep an eye out for anything useful and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Uli — I appreciate it. I’ll keep you posted if anything else comes up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, it’s still set for Sunday at the community center, and we can always use extra tools and hands. Just send anyone who can help my way!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it—I can send a few extra tools and see if anyone can lend a hand on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful, thanks! Send them my way on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch. I’ll send the full details and school times next.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Opal — that helps. Once you send the full details, I’ll check the timing and see if we’re still short on any tools.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’ll send the full repair drive details and school times shortly so you can check the tools.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, see you at 6:30.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, I’ll be there at 6:30. Just let me know if you need me to bring anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, could you bring the screwdriver and gloves? See you at 6:30.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh right, it’s been moved to Sunday at the community center — I’ll keep spreading the word around the block.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Vik — Sunday at the community center works. Send me the school times when you can, and I’ll help fit it around them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll send you the school times as soon as I have them, and I’ll keep letting neighbors know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: We’re still figuring it out, but I’m looking at a couple dates now. I’ll let you know as soon as it’s pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, thanks — just let me know when it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do — I’m hoping to lock it in soon, and I’ll pass along the date as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still trying to get the details straight—what do you need fixed, and is there a time I should pass along?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still waiting on the final list and start time, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll tell folks the list and start time are still pending, and to wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Just a quick update—the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the front porch. Thanks again for helping keep things on track.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo — Sunday at the community center works. I’ll send the volunteers’ names as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Uli — I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming, the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — it’s still on. I’ll send the repair drive details and the school times next.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — please send the details and school times when you can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s now Sunday at the community center, and I can still help—what else do you need?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s great, Mara—thanks. I can still bring my drill and a few screwdrivers, and maybe a tape measure too if we need it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Gus — those will help a lot. I’ll check what else is needed and let you know before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. Do you still need any tools or extra hands?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, a few extra hands would be great—please spread the word that it’s now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out for the repair drive details and school times.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — let me know when you hear the new details. I think it’s at the community center on Sunday now, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll ask around while I’m out and confirm it. Community center on Sunday sounds right, but I want to double-check the details and school times.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details again—when it is and what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — it’s on Sunday at the community center now. We’ll be tackling a few small home repairs, and if you can bring any tools or supplies, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center, got it. I’ll check what tools I can bring.
